title: Cosy Travel Carrier for Small Dogs
description:
Give your small dog a snug, secure spot for every journey. This soft-sided carrier has a padded, cushioned base that takes the jolt out of car rides and pavement walks alike, while mesh panels on three sides keep the air flowing so your dog can see out and stay comfortable.

It folds flat for easy storage between trips and the front zip opens wide for quick, fuss-free access. A sturdy top handle and an adjustable shoulder strap mean you can carry it however suits you best, hands-free on the school run or slung over one shoulder at the vet.

We designed this with nervous first-time travellers in mind: the enclosed sides give a den-like sense of security, while the mesh keeps things from feeling stuffy. Machine washable lining means it is easy to keep fresh between adventures.
short_description: A soft-sided carrier designed for small dogs on the move, with a padded base and mesh windows for airflow.
features: Padded, cushioned base for a comfortable ride
Mesh side panels for airflow and visibility
Adjustable shoulder strap plus top carry handle
Front zip opening for easy in and out

specifications.Care: Wipe clean, removable liner is machine washable

meta_title: Cosy Travel Carrier for Small Dogs | Pet Carrier
meta_description: A soft-sided carrier designed for small dogs on the move, with a padded base and mesh windows for airflow.

faqs.question: Will this fit under an aeroplane seat?
faqs.answer: Many airlines accept carriers of this size as cabin baggage, but requirements vary. Please check with your airline before you fly.

faqs.question: Is it machine washable?
faqs.answer: The removable interior liner can be machine washed on a gentle cycle. The outer fabric should be wiped clean.

title: Rolling Pet Carrier with Wheels for Medium Dogs
description:
For days when carrying just is not practical, this wheeled carrier lets your dog ride along in comfort while you push or pull rather than lift. Smooth-rolling wheels and a telescopic handle make it easy to manage through busy stations, long terminals or car parks.

Inside, a fleece-lined base cushions every trip, and mesh panels on the sides and top keep your dog cool and able to see their surroundings. The carrier can also be carried by its top and side handles when wheels are not the practical choice, such as on stairs.

We built this for owners who travel often with a medium-sized companion and want a calmer, steadier way to get from A to B.
short_description: A wheeled carrier that turns long walks and airport transfers into an easy roll, built for medium-sized dogs.
features: Mesh panels on sides and top for ventilation
Multiple carry handles for stairs and tight spaces

title: Hard-Shell Travel Crate for Dogs
description:
When you need something sturdier than a soft carrier, this hard-shell crate offers a secure, well-ventilated space your dog can settle into. Vents on all sides keep air moving, while the rigid shell protects against knocks in the boot of the car.

The front-facing, secure-latch door gives your dog a clear view out and keeps them settled during the drive, and the removable base tray makes cleaning up after a long journey simple.

We recommend letting your dog explore the crate at home for a few days before travelling, so it becomes a familiar, comforting space rather than a new one.
short_description: A rigid, well-ventilated travel crate built for car journeys and longer trips away from home.
features: Ventilation slots on all four sides
Removable base tray for easy cleaning

specifications.Care: Wipe clean, tray is dishwasher safe

title: Backpack Carrier for Small Dogs
description:
Some adventures call for both hands free. This backpack carrier lets your small dog ride along on your back, safely secured with an inner clip and supported by a padded, breathable base.

A clear bubble window on one side lets your dog watch the world go by while mesh panels elsewhere keep air circulating. Padded, adjustable straps and a supportive waist belt spread the weight comfortably across your shoulders and hips, even on longer walks.

Great for city breaks, countryside walks or simply nipping to the shops when little legs need a rest.
short_description: A hands-free backpack carrier with a bubble window, ideal for city walks, hikes and days out.
features: Padded, adjustable shoulder straps and waist belt
Side pocket for treats, poo bags and keys

title: Soft-Sided Carrier for Cats
description:
Cats tend to feel safest when they cannot be seen, and this carrier is built with that in mind. The mostly enclosed design gives a den-like feel, while a mesh panel on top and a small side window let you check in without fully opening the carrier.

A plush, removable cushion lines the base for a comfortable ride, and the top-loading opening makes it far easier to get a reluctant cat inside than a front-only door ever could.

We suggest leaving the carrier out at home with a blanket inside a week or two before a big trip, so your cat has time to see it as a safe space rather than a signal that the vet is coming.
short_description: A calm, enclosed carrier designed to help nervous cats feel settled on vet visits and short trips.
features: Top-loading opening for easy, low-stress access
Mostly enclosed design for a den-like feel
Lightweight to carry over one shoulder
meta_title: Soft-Sided Carrier for Cats | Pet Carrier
meta_description: A calm, enclosed carrier designed to help nervous cats feel settled on vet visits and short trips.

faqs.question: Will my cat feel too enclosed?
faqs.answer: The mesh panels keep air moving and let in enough light while still giving a secure, covered feeling that most cats find reassuring.

A reliable, no-fuss option for cat owners who need something a little tougher than fabric alone.

title: Cat Sling Carrier for Short Trips
description:
For quick trips where a full carrier feels like overkill, this sling holds your cat snugly against you, close enough that they can feel your movement and hear your voice, which many cats find calming.

Breathable mesh panelling keeps things ventilated, and the adjustable strap fits comfortably across one shoulder. It folds down small enough to keep in a bag for unplanned trips to the vet or a friend's house.

Not intended as a replacement for a full carrier on longer journeys, but a handy, comforting option for short hops.

description:
Rabbits and guinea pigs feel most at ease with somewhere to burrow, and this carrier gives them just that with a wide, flat base that leaves room for hay and bedding on the way to the vet or a friend's house.

Mesh panelling on the sides and door keeps air flowing without letting in a draught, and a top handle makes it easy to carry steadily, which matters more to small, easily startled animals than it might to a larger pet.

The base lifts out for a quick clean between trips, so mess is never a lasting problem.

title: Travel Cage for Small Birds
description:
Travelling with a bird calls for something secure enough to prevent escape but calm enough not to cause distress, and this travel cage aims for exactly that balance. Two internal perches give your bird somewhere familiar to settle, while bars spaced for small species keep them safely inside.

A fold-out feeding tray sits at the base for seed and water on longer trips, and the sliding door locks firmly shut. The whole cage lifts by a single top handle, kept centred so it does not tip during transport.

We recommend covering one side with a light cloth during travel to help reduce stress for more nervous birds.
